name: Rhys Llewellyn
bio:
Rhys's motorsport journey began tinkering with engines on his family's farm in rural Wales. He quickly developed a knack for understanding how things worked and a passion for pushing limits. After earning a degree in mechanical engineering, Rhys transitioned to a test driver role before finding his true calling in coordination, where he could blend his technical knowledge with his ability to organize and motivate. 

At Racing Bulls, Rhys oversees the test driver program, ensuring that every on-track session generates maximum data and insight for the team. He believes in fostering a collaborative environment where drivers, engineers, and data analysts can freely exchange ideas. Rhys's creative problem-solving skills and 'big picture' thinking consistently lead to innovative testing strategies and improved car performance.

physical.hairStyle: short, neatly cropped with a slight wave
physical.description: Rhys is of average height, with a lean build and an intense, focused gaze.

quirks: Always carries a worn-out notebook filled with handwritten notes and diagrams.
Has a habit of tapping his pen against his teeth when deep in thought.
Insists on starting every morning with a strong cup of Welsh tea.
